fields.title: Spotify chart record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Spotify's chart data, plus rank movement computed against the previous run. One CHART_ENTRY row per ranked item, CHART_EXIT rows for tracks that fell off, one CHART_SUMMARY row per chart, ERROR rows on failure. Spotify adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The chart this record came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: pathfinder-fetchPlaylist for country charts, charts-public-v0 for the tokenless global weekly charts, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: chart_not_found, unparsable_input or fetch_failed.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic accompanying _error. Retired charts such as the Viral 50 are named explicitly here.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Current chart position, 1 being the top.

previousRank.title: Previous rank
previousRank.description: Position in the previous reading. For country charts this comes from the previous run; for the public global charts it is Spotify's own figure.

rankChange.title: Rank change
rankChange.description: Positions gained since the previous reading. Positive means it climbed.

entryStatus.title: Entry status
entryStatus.description: MOVED_UP, MOVED_DOWN, NO_CHANGE, NEW_ENTRY, DROPPED_OUT, or BASELINE on the very first run when there was nothing to compare against.

chartName.title: Chart
chartName.description: Chart title as Spotify publishes it, for example Top 50 - Indonesia.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code, GLOBAL, or CUSTOM for a playlist supplied by URL.

chartId.title: Chart id
chartId.description: Spotify playlist id behind the chart.

chartAlias.title: Chart alias
chartAlias.description: Public charts service only: Spotify's own identifier, for example REGIONAL_GLOBAL_WEEKLY.

chartDate.title: Chart date
chartDate.description: Public charts service only: the date the chart covers.

chartLastUpdated.title: Last recalculated
chartLastUpdated.description: When Spotify last recalculated this chart.

rankType.title: Ranking basis
rankType.description: What the ranking counts, for example plays.

chartEntityType.title: Chart entity type
chartEntityType.description: What is being ranked: track, album or artist.

trackName.title: Track
trackName.description: Song title. Country charts rank tracks.

artistNames.title: All artists
artistNames.description: Every credited artist, in Spotify's own order.

artistUrl.title: Artist URL
artistUrl.description: open.spotify.com link to the main artist.

albumName.title: Album
albumName.description: Release the charting recording belongs to.

playcount.title: Play count
playcount.description: Lifetime streams for the charting recording. Spotify's official API never publishes this.

trackUri.title: Track URI
trackUri.description: spotify:track: URI, and the key rank movement is matched on between runs.

explicit.title: Explicit
explicit.description: True when Spotify labels the recording explicit.

coverArt.title: Cover art
coverArt.description: Largest cover image Spotify offers for the entry.

entityType.title: Entity type
entityType.description: Public charts service only: TRACK, ALBUM or ARTIST.

entityName.title: Entity name
entityName.description: Public charts service only: the name of the ranked track, album or artist.

entityUrl.title: Entity URL
entityUrl.description: Public charts service only: open.spotify.com link to the ranked item.

peakRank.title: Peak rank
peakRank.description: Public charts service only: best position ever reached, when Spotify publishes it.

appearancesOnChart.title: Weeks on chart
appearancesOnChart.description: Public charts service only: total appearances, when Spotify publishes it.

consecutiveAppearances.title: Consecutive weeks
consecutiveAppearances.description: Public charts service only: unbroken run on the chart, when Spotify publishes it.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Public charts service only: record labels credited, when published.

songwriters.title: Songwriters
songwriters.description: Public charts service only: songwriter credits, when published.

producers.title: Producers
producers.description: Public charts service only: producer credits, when published.

followers.title: Chart followers
followers.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: accounts following the chart playlist.

entryCount.title: Entries
entryCount.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: how many items the chart holds.

entriesCompared.title: Entries compared
entriesCompared.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: how many entries had a previous position to compare against.

newEntries.title: New entries
newEntries.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: entries that were not on the chart in the previous reading.

newEntriesReported.title: New entries (Spotify's count)
newEntriesReported.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: Spotify's own new-entry total from the chart attributes. It names no tracks, which is why the actor computes its own.

climbers.title: Climbers
climbers.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: entries that gained positions.

fallers.title: Fallers
fallers.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: entries that lost positions.

biggestClimbName.title: Biggest climber
biggestClimbName.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: the entry that gained the most positions.

biggestClimbPositions.title: Biggest climb
biggestClimbPositions.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: how many positions it gained.

newEntryNames.title: New entry names
newEntryNames.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: up to ten of the new entries, by name.

description.title: Chart description
description.description: CHART_SUMMARY rows: Spotify's description of the chart.
